content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Ghana is not alone in this issue, as many countries face restrictions on using popular payment platforms like Stripe. This is where the NOWPayments digital store infrastructure comes in – a sovereign solution that allows creators to receive crypto payments directly, without relying on platforms that can restrict or block their access. By using NOWPayments, you can tap into a wide range of cryptocurrencies and reach a global audience, all while maintaining full control over your online commerce stack.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your NOWPayments digital store, you'll need to gather a few key components. These include the NOWPayments SDK, a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting, and a Supabase or Google Sheets account for order storage. You'll also need to set up a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery. Additionally, you'll need to have a basic understanding of JavaScript and HTML to configure the infrastructure correctly.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure the NOWPayments SDK to work with your chosen cryptocurrency. You'll also need to set up a webhook to receive notifications when a payment is made. Once you've done this, you can configure your file delivery pipeline to use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that your digital products are delivered securely and efficiently to your customers.
NOWPayments offers fast and secure USDT payments with fees under $0.10 per transaction on the Tron network.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Going live with your NOWPayments digital store is a straightforward process. Simply deploy your infrastructure, configure your payment and delivery pipelines, and test everything to ensure it's working correctly. Once you've done this, you can start processing transactions and receiving payments from your customers. With NOWPayments, you can expect to receive USDT payments in under 10 minutes, thanks to the low fees and fast settlement times on the Tron network.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital store grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to keep up with demand. With this kit, you can easily add new features and functionality to your store, and optimize your payment and delivery pipelines for maximum efficiency.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a NOWPayments digital store, follow these concrete steps: Create a NOWPayments account and set up your payment configuration; Configure your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting; Set up a Supabase or Google Sheets account for order storage; Configure your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery; Deploy your infrastructure and test everything to ensure it's working correctly; Set up a webhook to receive notifications when a payment is made; Optimize your payment and delivery pipelines for maximum efficiency.

How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account and configure your payment configuration. You can then integrate the NOWPayments SDK into your digital store to start receiving payments from your customers.

USDT payments on the Tron network arrive in under 10 minutes, thanks to the low fees and fast settlement times. This is significantly faster than PayPal, which can take several days to process payments.
